moments.text: Colour camera over blue sea with a centre crosshair. A small light spot sits just right of and below the crosshair as the sensor follows it.
The screen goes black for half a second, then the view switches to grey-scale infrared.
In infrared the spot is a bright white blob right of the crosshair, sometimes with a faint thin line hanging below it.
The blob drifts to the right edge, then the sensor swings and brings it back toward the centre.
The blob slips out at the right edge for under a second, then reappears above and right of the crosshair.
The view switches to colour and widens: open sea up to a bright horizon along the top. About 1 s.
Back in grey-scale, the bright spot sweeps in at the lower right, swings left, then slides out the right edge. Under 1 s.

notes: White pillarbox bars on both sides (~15% each, picture x~288-1638 of 1920) are not cropped; cropdetect only removes black.
